changes.title: Enter Palace / Enter 3D from the default All Memories state passes wingId '__all__' into 3D nav â€” blank scene
changes.evidence: handleEnter3D (1139-1147) calls enterWingRoom(selectedWing, selectedRoom)/enterCorridor(selectedWing) with selectedWing defaulting to '__all__' (414). palaceStore.ts:109-112 blindly stores it; useNavigation.ts:30 resolves wingData=null; MemoryPalace.tsx:1147 gates CorridorScene on wingData so nothing mounts and the loading overlay auto-hides to a blank 3D view (MemoryPalace.tsx:494/519-529). Reachable from the sidebar Enter-3D button (LibrarySidebar.tsx:1091) and the mobile Enter Palace button (1460). Room variant: room selection never rewrites selectedWing, so enterWingRoom('__all__', roomId) mounts InteriorScene with a bogus wing id.
changes.fix: In handleEnter3D: if selectedRoom, resolve the real wing via roomWingMap[selectedRoom] before enterWingRoom; if selectedWing==='__all__' with no room, call enterEntrance()/exitToPalace() instead of enterCorridor('__all__'). Also fix the mislabeled sidebar button (LibrarySidebar.tsx:1123: pass selectedWingName undefined when '__all__' so it falls back to t('enterPalace')).

changes.title: Stale selectMode survives leaving a room: wall clicks hijacked, select-all + delete runs deleteMemory(null) â€” real server-side deletions with a UI that never updates
changes.evidence: No navigation path resets selectMode/selectedMemIds (handleBackToRooms 1057-1062, onSelectRoom 1181/1208/1400, wing pills). The Select/Done toggle only renders inside a room (1682) but the bulk bar renders on bare selectMode (2033) and PhotoWall gets selectMode in ALL scopes (2219) â€” tile clicks stop opening the viewer (PhotoWall.tsx:222). Select-all (2042-2048) then selects the whole palace and delete runs deleteMemory(selectedRoom!, memId) (2061) with selectedRoom=null: memoryStore.ts:311-325 writes userMems['null'] locally but still calls deleteMemoryAction(memId) server-side per id. Bulk move/tag silently no-op in the same state (1127, 2124).
changes.fix: Reset selectMode/selectedMemIds/showBatchTag whenever scope changes (useEffect on [selectedRoom, selectedWing] plus in handleBackToRooms). In bulk delete/move/tag, resolve each memory's real room via memRoomMap.get(memId)?.roomId instead of selectedRoom!; hard-guard the delete handler with if(!selectedRoom && !memRoomMap-resolution) return.

changes.title: Dropbox/OneDrive cloud import silently discards the user's selection when no room is selected (the Library's default state)
changes.evidence: CloudBrowser onImport: if (selectedRoom && items.length > 0) {...fetch...} setCloudBrowserProvider(null); (2820-2854). Default Library state is selectedWing='__all__', selectedRoom=null, and the Import pill (1632) is available there. User selects files, clicks 'Import n selected' (CloudBrowser 384), guard fails, modal closes â€” zero feedback, selection thrown away.
changes.fix: Thread an explicit target roomId into the cloud flow (from ImportHub's targetRoomId â€” see rank 6); if none resolvable, show an error/room-picker instead of silently closing. Never close the modal on a skipped import.

changes.title: RoomMediaPlayer crashes (TypeError on m.type) or silently swaps memories when the live filtered array shrinks during an inline edit
changes.evidence: memories is the live filteredRoomMems (LibraryView.tsx:2587). The player's inline title/desc editors call onUpdate â†’ updateMemory, which can drop the current mem out of an active search/facet filter; const mem = memories[index] (51) shifts or becomes undefined, and getMediaType(mem) (149) executes m.type.toLowerCase() (141) on undefined â†’ uncaught TypeError white-screening the overlay. index is only clamped at mount (36).
changes.fix: Track the current memory by id (derive index via findIndex on id, re-clamp when memories changes, close/return null when it disappears); at minimum guard getMediaType behind if(!mem).

changes.title: Timeline click opens the WRONG memory in RoomMediaPlayer whenever sortMode is not 'newest'
changes.evidence: Timeline re-sorts locally: const sorted = [...filteredRoomMems.slice(0, visibleMemCount)].sort(byCreatedAtDesc) (2288/2310) and item onClick does setMediaPlayerIndex(i) with i indexing sorted (2326/2348). RoomMediaPlayer receives the un-resorted memories={filteredRoomMems} initialIndex={mediaPlayerIndex} (2586-2610). With sortMode oldest/alpha/type (persisted via mobile sort sheet, 467/1506) the orders diverge â€” tapping an entry opens a different memory. Grid is safe (PhotoWall passes original _i, PhotoWall.tsx:218-222).
changes.fix: Pass identity, not position: setMediaPlayerIndex(filteredRoomMems.findIndex(m => m.id === mem.id)) in the timeline onClick (or hand the sorted array itself to the player).

changes.title: ImportHub's Destination wing/room selector is ignored for ALL cloud providers; Google Photos picker fails with 'no room' only AFTER the user finishes picking
changes.evidence: ImportHub renders a Destination selector (targetWingId/targetRoomId, 505-580) directly above the cloud buttons, but onOpenCloudProvider is typed (provider: string) => void (91) and invoked without the room (706) â€” only local-file import passes targetRoomId (351). LibraryView's handleCloudProvider then uses selectedRoom (584/592); the Google Photos flow stores roomId:null, sends the user through the full external Picker, and only at completion hits the 'no room' error (LibraryView.tsx:645-650), persisting the stale null to localStorage (582-584, resumed 681-696).
changes.fix: Change the prop to onOpenCloudProvider(provider, roomId) passing targetRoomId; use that roomId in handleCloudProvider, startPickerPolling and CloudBrowser's onImport instead of selectedRoom; refuse to start the picker with no room resolved. Root-cause fix for rank 3.

changes.title: Persisted list/timeline viewMode applies to the whole wall where the view toggle is hidden â€” user stuck out of grid; retired list view still shipped and persisted
changes.evidence: viewMode hydrates unvalidated from localStorage including 'list' (427-432) and the content render branches on it for EVERY scope (2211+: grid/list(2230)/timeline(2301)), but the grid/list/timeline toggle only renders {selectedRoom && ...} (1700). A user who last used list/timeline in a room gets the default all-memories wall as a flat capped list with no control to escape. The list button (1712) and full list branch contradict the retired-list architecture; the Month/Rooms lens toggle stays visible but only affects PhotoWall (2198).
changes.fix: Force grid when !selectedRoom (const effectiveView = selectedRoom ? viewMode : 'grid'). Retire list fully: remove the button (1712-1714) and branch (2230-2300), narrow the union to 'grid'|'timeline', and migrate/validate persisted values on read (like sortMode does at 468).

changes.title: Search inside a wing is hijacked by crossWingResults: wing scope AND filterType/facet/filterYear silently stop compounding
changes.evidence: crossWingResults (919-940) fires whenever q && !selectedRoom && selectedWing !== '__all__' and matches memories across ALL wings on the query string only â€” no filterType/facet/filterYear in the predicate or deps. When non-null it replaces the wall entirely (render at 1723, wall gated by !crossWingResults at 2030) while the active filter pills stay lit (1591-1608). The correctly-scoped filteredRoomMems (886-902) is never shown. Header count, badge and list can show three different numbers (1534/998).
changes.fix: Share one predicate helper: apply filterType/facet/filterYear inside crossWingResults, and render 'in this wing' (scoped, fully filtered wall) separate from a clearly-labeled 'elsewhere in your palace' section; feed the header/badge one consistent count.

changes.title: Search result badge always shows '0 found' on the default All Memories wall
changes.evidence: searchResultCount (995-1001): if(!query) undefined; if(selectedRoom) filteredRoomMems.length; if(crossWingResults) its length; return 0. On the default scope crossWingResults is hard-nulled (920: '__all__' guard) so every query returns 0 â€” while the wall renders real matches from filteredRoomMems (890, fed to PhotoWall 2194). LibrarySearch shows 'foundCount 0' (LibrarySearch.tsx:110/216) on both mobile (1435) and desktop (1549).
changes.fix: Add a branch before crossWingResults: if (selectedRoom || selectedWing === '__all__') return filteredRoomMems.length.

changes.title: Timeline paginates BEFORE re-sorting and silently overrides the user's sort choice â€” 'Load more' interleaves new items anywhere
changes.evidence: [...filteredRoomMems.slice(0, visibleMemCount)].sort(newestFirst) (2288-2289) takes the first 50 in the user's chosen order then force-resorts newest-first: (a) sort control has zero visible effect in timeline; (b) with 'oldest' the first page is the 50 OLDEST rendered newest-first; (c) Load more (2391) appends the next 50 of the other ordering, which the re-sort interleaves between groups the user already scrolled past.
changes.fix: If timeline is always-chronological, sort the FULL array then slice: [...filteredRoomMems].sort(byDateDesc).slice(0, visibleMemCount), and hide/disable non-chronological sort options in timeline mode; honor 'oldest' by ascending order. Memoize the derivation.

changes.title: 'Oldest'/'alpha'/'type' sort has essentially no effect on the default grid wall â€” PhotoWall month sections are always forced newest-first
changes.evidence: PhotoWall re-buckets the already-sorted mems into month sections and unconditionally orders sections newestâ†’oldest (152-156: b.key.localeCompare(a.key)). With sortMode='oldest' bands descend while tiles inside ascend â€” self-contradictory; alpha/type order is destroyed by banding. Grid is the only view outside a room and the default entry, so the mobile sort popup (1506) visibly does almost nothing exactly where it is offered.
changes.fix: Pass sortMode into PhotoWall: for 'oldest' sort sections ascending; for 'alpha'/'type' skip month banding (single section or letter/type bands); or disable those options while the grid wall is active.

changes.title: Sort control exists only on mobile; desktop silently applies a persisted sort it cannot see or change
changes.evidence: The ONLY setSortMode call site (1487) is inside the mobile sort popup (1457-1518) within the isMobile branch (1218). sortMode hydrates from localStorage on every mount (468) and sorts filteredRoomMems (903-911), so a value set on a narrow window keeps re-sorting the desktop Library with no visible control or indicator (grep: no sort UI in the desktop branch, LibrarySearch or LibrarySidebar).
changes.fix: Add the same sort dropdown to the desktop control band (next to the Month/Rooms lens toggle, 1598-1603), driven by the existing sortMode state. Also fix the comparator to use createdAt || date like every other date path (905, cf. 871/899/901).

changes.title: Global Escape chain misses CloudBrowser, Google-picker, PublishModal, bulk-move AND all three tool panels â€” Esc navigates underneath and leaves activeToolPanel armed to reopen stale
changes.evidence: The Escape handler (1064-1080) checks showImportHub/mediaPlayerIndex/lightboxMem/detailPanelMem/movingMem/detailMem/showUploadFor then falls through to handleBackToRooms. It never checks cloudBrowserProvider, pickerStatus, showPublishModal, bulkMoving, or activeToolPanel. Consequences: Esc with CloudBrowser open exits the room BEHIND the modal, nulling the selectedRoom the import depends on; Esc with AI-label/Write-Story/Add-Location open unmounts the panel via selectedRoom=null while activeToolPanel + drafts/results stay populated â€” selecting ANY room later instantly re-opens the panel with stale content (gates at 2926/3010/3150; handleBackToRooms 1057-1062 clears none of it).
changes.fix: Add branches at the top of the chain (and to the dep array): cloudBrowserProvider â†’ close it; pickerStatus!=='idle' â†’ cancel; showPublishModal â†’ return (its own handler closes); bulkMoving â†’ close; activeToolPanel â†’ handleClosePanel()/setActiveToolPanel(null)+reset drafts. Belt-and-braces: also clear activeToolPanel inside handleBackToRooms.

changes.title: Escape while inline-editing title/description closes the whole player and discards the edit
changes.evidence: RoomMediaPlayer's input onKeyDown cancels the edit on Escape (513, 560) but never calls e.stopPropagation(), so the event bubbles to LibraryView's window handler (LibraryView.tsx:1066-1068) which does setMediaPlayerIndex(null) â€” unmounting the player mid-edit. The player's own window handler guards editing (75); the parent's does not.
changes.fix: Call e.stopPropagation() in the title/desc Escape branches (and in the player's own Escape path), or have LibraryView's handler skip Escape when (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea').

changes.title: Swipe detection bound to the entire overlay: scrolling the thumbnail strip or dragging a video/audio seek bar triggers prev/next navigation
changes.evidence: onTouchStart/onTouchEnd live on the root fixed container (368-371); handleTouchEnd fires goNext/goPrev on any horizontal move >50px within 500ms (126-129). The thumbnail strip is a horizontally scrollable child (617-625) and the native seek sliders (198-211, 266-274) are horizontal touches â€” both yank the user to another memory.
changes.fix: Attach the touch handlers only to the main media area div (453), or bail when e.target.closest('.rmp-thumb, video, audio, button, input, textarea') matches; also suppress swipe while zoom > 1.

changes.title: Opening a 'document' memory renders its raw base64 dataUrl as story text; no viewer or download
changes.evidence: getMediaType maps document/story/documentBlob to 'text' (145) and the text renderer prints {mem.desc || mem.dataUrl || t('mediaPlayerNoContent')} (321). UploadPanel stores documents as data URLs (UploadPanel.tsx:107-141), so a description-less document shows a wall of 'data:application/pdf;base64,...'. Legacy type 'voice' (mapped to text at 143 before the voiceBlob check at 144) prints data:audio base64.
changes.fix: In the text branch treat dataUrl starting with data:/api:/http as a file: render an open/download affordance (anchor/iframe) for documents; route 'voice' with an audio dataUrl to the audio renderer.

changes.title: No real cancel on AI labeling: closing the panel mid-run keeps POSTing /api/ai-label (paid calls), and the orphaned loop resurrects stale 'Done!' state
changes.evidence: handleStartLabeling loops await fetch('/api/ai-label') per photo with no AbortController and no cancelled check (2992-3009/3019-3028). handleClosePanel resets state but the async closure keeps running, repopulating aiLabelResults and finally setAiLabelDone(true) (3007/3029). Reopening later shows a stale done screen; if the user changed rooms, the done-state Save runs updateMemory(selectedRoom!, oldMemId) against the WRONG room while updateMemoryAction still persists server-side.
changes.fix: Hold a run-id ref/AbortController: snapshot at loop start, check after each await, bump/abort in handleClosePanel; never write final state from a dead run.

changes.title: AI-label run where every photo fails still shows green 'Done! 0 photos successfully labeled' with a disabled 'Saved' button
changes.evidence: setAiLabelDone(true) is unconditional after the loop (3007). Total failure (server down, 401, 429, 503 â€” every non-403 just failCount++/continue at 3002/3005) leaves aiLabelResults={}: the banner renders 'Done! 0 photos' in success-green (3051) and the footer's save-all disabled condition is vacuously true on an empty object, labeled 'Saved' (3120). The selection grid is hidden (3059) so retry requires close+reopen.
changes.fix: Track successes in a local variable and only setAiLabelDone(successes>0); on total failure keep the selection grid visible with the error banner. Also stop hammering the API on guaranteed-repeat statuses: abort the loop on 401/429/503 with status-specific i18n messages (mirror the 403 branch).

changes.title: Atrium 'ai-enhance' spotlight is fully unwired: no consumer, target button doesn't exist on Library landing, pulse keyframes never applied
changes.evidence: HomeView sets mp_spotlight_target='ai-enhance' (HomeView.tsx:744/1159); LibraryView maps it to 'aiLabel' (533) but (1) no element carries data-spotlight-id='aiLabel' or checks it â€” the only consumer is the importUpload pill (1613/1632); (2) the aiLabel pill only renders with a selectedRoom (1609) while the Library lands on '__all__'; (3) @keyframes spotlightPulse (1144/1161) is referenced by nothing repo-wide. Clicking the Atrium 'Restore a Photo' card silently does nothing; state auto-clears after 5s (548). Same for 'write-stories'/'organize'/'import-cloud' mappings.
changes.fix: Either make spotlight targets real: apply animation: spotlightPulse + data-spotlight-id to the tool pills, map 'import-cloud', and have room-scoped targets auto-select a sensible room / open the panel; or delete the whole spotlight state machine + keyframes.

changes.title: Right-click / long-press toggles selection outside select mode: phantom selected tiles with no bulk UI, native context menu always suppressed
changes.evidence: onContextMenu={(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); onToggleSelect(item.id);}} is unconditional (219-223) and selected styling keys off selectedMemIds alone (gold inset 227/239 + badge 236-249). The bulk bar needs selectMode (LibraryView.tsx:2033) and the Select toggle needs a room (1663), so on the wall a right-click/long-press marks tiles with nothing to act on and no visible clear; entering select mode later wipes the set (1684). e.preventDefault also kills Save-Image in normal mode.
changes.fix: Gate on selectMode, or make it the select-mode entry point: onEnterSelect(id) prop that sets selectMode=true and seeds the set (requires scope-safe bulk ops from rank 2).

changes.title: Real-AR repack check reads the fallback without mem type â€” square photos never trigger a repack; correct-AR photos trigger spurious ones
changes.evidence: onMeasured: const prev = getAspect(id); ... if (Math.abs(prev - ar) > 0.02 ...) (117-121). getAspect without a type returns 1.0 (justify.ts:33-35) while the wall packed the tile at 1.5 for photo/video (justify.ts:16-26, PhotoWall.tsx:165). A square photo measures ~1.0 == prev â†’ no arVersion bump â†’ the 3:2 fallback layout can persist permanently; a photo measuring exactly 1.5 computes diff 0.5 â†’ useless repack. Wrong in both directions.
changes.fix: Thread the type: onMeasured(id, type, ar) (TileMedia has mem) and compute prev = getAspect(id, type) before setAspect.

changes.title: Scrubber tick column is unbounded â€” on multi-year libraries older-month ticks render below the viewport and are permanently unreachable
changes.evidence: One ~11px button per non-empty month with no cap/maxHeight/year condensation (183+) inside a sticky top:0 height:0 wrapper (181-182): ~65+ sections exceed a viewport and the column scrolls WITH the viewport, so past-the-fold ticks stay unreachable forever; the overflow also forms a zIndex:6 tap-stealing strip. The spec targets 10k-item lifetime walls where overflow is guaranteed. On mobile the -0.1rem offset additionally overlaps the rightmost tiles (182) stealing photo taps.
changes.fix: Condense to year ticks past a threshold (or maxHeight:100vh with proportional offsetTop mapping per spec) so every period stays reachable; reserve a real gutter on mobile so ticks never overlap tiles.

changes.title: Scrubber has no drag/touch interaction and no month labels on mobile â€” spec'd drag-with-bubble unimplemented
changes.evidence: Click-only ticks with mouse-hover labels (onClick scrollIntoView 187, onMouseEnter 188); zero pointer/touch handlers in the file. On touch, hover doesn't exist so the month bubble (192-194) is unreachable before committing â€” mobile users blind-tap unlabeled ~3px ticks. Mapping is ordinal, not the spec'd positional offsetTop mapping (docs/LIBRARY_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION.json rank 8).
changes.fix: Add pointer-drag on the rail (onPointerDown/Move with setPointerCapture): map pointer Y to nearest tick, show the label bubble during drag, scrollIntoView on pointerup; keep click for desktop; clear scrubHover on tap so the bubble doesn't stick.

changes.title: Externally cleared search query resurrects after 300ms â€” pending debounce timer not cancelled on external reset
changes.evidence: The external-sync effect (62-67) only does setLocalQuery(query) and never touches debounceRef; handleQueryChange (70-81) schedules onQueryChange after 300ms. LibraryView clears externally via the âœ• pill (1585) and Escapeâ†’handleBackToRooms (1056-1074): a keystroke within 300ms of the clear fires the stale timer and the search comes back â€” in the Escape case silently filtering the wall the user just returned to.
changes.fix: In the sync effect: if (query !== localQuery) { if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current); setLocalQuery(query); }.

changes.title: Type filter is unreachable dead code: filterType state filters the pipeline but no UI ever sets it
changes.evidence: filterType (417) is applied at 896 but the only setters are setFilterType(null) (1059, 1585). LibraryFilterBar (LibrarySearch.tsx:294) is not rendered by LibraryView; roomTypes memo (988) is computed and unused. Every branch keyed on filterType â€” anyActive (1568), empty-state type (2369) â€” is dead. Users have no type filter in the Library at all.
changes.fix: Either render a type-filter control (reuse LibraryFilterBar with normalized types from the current scope, wired to setFilterType, labels through t()) or delete filterType + roomTypes + the dead branches.

changes.title: Selecting a room from the All-scope room bar never sets selectedWing â€” breaks 3D deep-link, upload/detail wing context, and accent identity
changes.evidence: The room bar shows ALL palace rooms when selectedWing==='__all__' (wingRooms 829-833) but its onClick only sets selectedRoom (1381; same at 1181/1208 and RoomManagerPanel onEnterRoom 2655-2659). With '__all__' left in place: handleEnter3D breaks (rank 1), currentWing silently falls back to wings[0] (1007) for accents/breadcrumb/RoomManagerPanel, and showUploadFor/setDetailMem leak wingId '__all__' â†’ UploadPanel/MemoryDetail get wing=null AND room=null (2635-2637, 2897). The only correct remap lives in the dead false&& block (~1946).
changes.fix: In every room-select handler: if the current wing is '__all__' or doesn't contain the room, also setSelectedWing(roomWingMap[room.id]); resolve the real wing at showUploadFor/setDetailMem use sites via roomWingMap.

changes.title: Mobile rooms-bar '+' (and All-scope Add room pill) silently creates rooms in wings[0]
changes.evidence: The add-room pill (1424, also 1405-1419) opens RoomManagerPanel with wing={currentWing} (2651-2653), and currentWing = wings.find(w=>w.id===selectedWing) || wings[0] (1008) â€” '__all__' never matches, so from the default all-memories view a created room lands in the first wing with no wing choice or indication. Same fallback also mis-tints the rooms bar with wings[0].accent (1381).
changes.fix: When selectedWing==='__all__', require a wing pick before RoomManagerPanel (wing picker step or hide the pill); tint All-scope room pills by their own wing via roomWingMap.

changes.title: 'On this day' facet counts and shows memories created TODAY (current year not excluded) â€” pill and gilt strip disagree on the same screen
changes.evidence: Facet filter (899) and pill count isOtd (1561) match month+day only; the strip memo correctly requires d.getFullYear() !== yr (971). On any upload day the pill counts brand-new photos as anniversaries and clicking the facet shows them, while the strip (correctly) shows nothing.
changes.fix: Add && d.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear() to both the facet predicate (899) and isOtd (1561) to match onThisDayMems semantics.

changes.title: Demo/sample memories surface in the gilt On This Day strip as personal anniversaries
changes.evidence: onThisDayMems iterates getMemsForRoom (966) = userMems[roomId] || getDemoMems(roomId) (854-856). Demo mems (defaults.ts:55-60) carry fixed dates and realistic titles ('The Day I Graduated'); on those month/days users with empty rooms see gilt-framed fake anniversaries with nothing marking them as examples. Demo mems also inflate the facet count (1559).
changes.fix: Filter demo memories out of onThisDayMems (skip demo-id-prefixed mems or iterate userMems only), or render strip entries with the example-media badge.

changes.title: Facet/year filters and slow fetches produce the wrong empty state: 'This room is waiting for you â€” Add your first memory' on populated scopes
changes.evidence: Two causes: (a) empty-state type only checks q/filterType (2391: type={(!!q||!!filterType)?'search':'room'}) but filteredRoomMems is also emptied by facet (898-901) and filterYear (902) â€” an 'On this day' day with no anniversaries tells a user with hundreds of memories their library is empty and pushes an add-first flow; (b) roomLoading is a fixed 300ms timer decoupled from the actual fetch (509-516) while data arrives via async fetchRoomMemories â€” any fetch >300ms flashes the same false empty state (2389-2396). The default '__all__' wall has no loading gate at all and shows room-scoped copy despite no room being selected.
changes.fix: (a) Widen the condition to all narrowing filters (q||filterType||facet||filterYear â‡’ 'search') and add a clear-filters action; add a 'library' copy variant for the '__all__' scope. (b) Tie roomLoading (and a wall-level loading flag) to fetchRoomMemories completion, keeping 300ms only as a minimum skeleton floor.

changes.title: Media route streams Supabase-backed files with the visitor's session client after authorizing published-wing access â€” storage RLS blocks the download, visitor gets 404
changes.evidence: The route authorizes non-owners for published wings (131-147) then streamFromSupabase downloads with the SESSION client (255-257). storage.objects SELECT policies cover only own files and shared rooms/wings (005_rls_policies.sql:92-116, 022_sharing_overhaul.sql:128-137) â€” no policy for published wings exists in supabase/migrations. Any supabase-backed memory in a published wing returns 404 to authorized visitors (259).
changes.fix: After route-level authorization succeeds, download with the admin client (createAdminClient) in streamFromSupabase, falling back to the session client only when SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is absent; or add a storage SELECT policy for published wings.

changes.title: 'Unplaced' facet pill is permanently disabled â€” count is 0 by construction
changes.evidence: Count: base.filter(m => !memRoomMap.get(m.id)?.roomId).length (1585), but base (1578) and memRoomMap (875-879) are built from the identical wingsâ†’roomsâ†’getMemsForRoom iteration â€” every mem in base has a truthy roomId. Count===0 always, so disabled = d.count===0 && !active (1594) keeps the pill at opacity 0.4/pointerEvents none forever; the facet branch at 901 can never match. A shipped control no user can ever use. (Related: unplaced memories also can't be edited/moved/deleted through the overlay chain, 2615-2617.)
changes.fix: Source 'unplaced' from a real unassigned pool (keps/attic uploads not grounded to a room, fetched outside the room iteration) or remove the pill + facet branch + the undated-room fallback chain.

changes.title: 'Clear examples' pill hides itself but demo memories stay on the wall â€” stale memo chain
changes.evidence: onClick does setDemosHidden(true); setShowDemos(false) â€” but setDemosHidden only writes localStorage (defaults.ts:85-90) and getMemsForRoom = useCallback((roomId)=> userMems[roomId] || getDemoMems(roomId), [userMems]) (854-856) keeps its identity, so allWingMems/libAllMems/memRoomMap/filteredRoomMems all stay cached with the demo memories until an unrelated userMems change or remount.
changes.fix: Make demo visibility part of React state flow: getMemsForRoom = useCallback((roomId)=> userMems[roomId] || (showDemos ? getDemoMems(roomId) : []), [userMems, showDemos]).

changes.title: getWings() returns a fresh array every render, defeating ALL palace-wide memoization â€” O(total mems) recompute per keystroke and full PhotoWall re-pack
changes.evidence: const wings = getWings() (413) runs per render; roomStore.getWings (roomStore.ts:138-142) maps to new objects each call. wings is a dep of nearly every heavy memo (wingRooms 829, libAllMems 865, memRoomMap 875, wingWarmth 944, onThisDayMems 961, roomWingMap 1011, crossWingResults 920) so every state change recomputes all palace-wide maps and hands PhotoWall a new mems identity (2214), forcing full section/justify re-packs. The control-band IIFE (1577-1586) adds four full base.filter passes per render.
changes.fix: Subscribe to stable store state (customWings/extraWings) and wrap getWings() output in useMemo keyed on it (or memoize in the store); useCallback the six PhotoWall props and wrap PhotoWall in React.memo; then verify the wall stops re-packing on unrelated state.

changes.title: Two demo-room nameKeys don't match any message key â€” English shown in nl/de/es/fr despite translations existing
changes.evidence: wings.ts:62 nameKey:'roomHouseOnElmStreet' and :67 'roomBigProject2019', but all 5 locales contain 'roomTheHouseOnElmStreet' and 'roomTheBigProject'. translateRoomName (44-48) falls back to hardcoded English when t() returns the raw key, so non-English users see 'The House on Elm Street' / 'The Big Project of 2019' untranslated everywhere the Library renders room names.
changes.fix: Rename the two nameKeys in wings.ts to match the existing keys ('roomTheHouseOnElmStreet', 'roomTheBigProject').

changes.title: Mobile sort popup cannot be dismissed by tapping outside or Escape

summary: The Library's unified-wall architecture holds, but the seams leak badly. Three P0s can lose data or strand users: Enter Palace from the default view opens a blank 3D scene, leftover select-mode silently deletes memories server-side while the wall keeps showing them, and cloud imports throw away the user's selection whenever no room is open. A correctness cluster follows: the timeline opens the WRONG memory unless sort is 'newest', search says '0 found' beside visible results, wing search silently drops all active filters, and the sort control mostly does nothing on the main wall. Escape handling is inconsistent across every overlay, and the AI-label panel keeps spending Anthropic money after Cancel and shows 'Done!' on total failure. Several shipped controls are dead on arrival: the type filter, the always-disabled 'Unplaced' pill, the Atrium spotlight deep-links, and the retired list view is still reachable via localStorage. The media pipeline needs attention â€” photos always load full-res originals against a 200/min rate limit, video tiles fire doomed .mp4 image requests on the default wall, and published-wing visitors 404 on Supabase-backed files. Visually the Library drifted off the Atrium canon (frosted glass, invisible cream borders, misspent gold, zero imports of libraryTokens); the merged cardBgSpec fixes it with a small exact-CSS set. Perf root cause: getWings() returns a fresh array every render, so every keystroke recomputes the whole palace and re-packs the wall. Fix order: the 3 P0s, then wrong-memory/search/sort correctness, then Escape/state hygiene, then the canon restyle â€” roughly 2-3 focused sessions, nothing architectural.
